prompt: Create a Python Builder CLI that reads a compact Alpine images.yaml, generates structured Dockerfiles locally, and builds temporary contexts in CI.
output: Added the independent Builder command and generic Jinja Dockerfile templates. Image collections use globally configurable, per-version-overridable users. Alpine and BusyBox templates use addgroup/adduser; Debian and Ubuntu use their native groupadd/useradd syntax and create an owned work directory. Added a separate manually triggered GitHub workflow with image selection, optional version selection, validation, Buildx publishing, SBOM, and provenance.
